description: Apep, the Egyptian god of chaos, works to release Pure Evil while the Librarians face prophecies, demons, magical cults and growing pressure from DOSA, pushing the team toward a two-front fight for the Library itself.

s03e01.description: The Egyptian god Apep returns in human form and seeks to release Pure Evil, sending the Librarians through a science museum where animated exhibits hide clues to stopping him.

s03e02.description: A rescue mission for Charlene becomes a trap beneath the earth, where Apep commands ancient werewolves and tries to eliminate the Librarians before they can interfere with his larger plan.

s03e03.description: An artifact fuses itself to Cassandra during a retrieval, and a blizzard strands her and Stone in a hotel hosting a gathering of demons eager to claim it.

s03e04.description: Baird sees a vision of her own murder by a supernatural assassin and tries to outmaneuver a prophecy whose every attempt at prevention may be helping it come true.

s03e05.description: A travelling carnival conceals a magician corrupted by genuine magic, forcing the team to separate stagecraft from dangerous supernatural power before the show consumes more victims.

s03e06.description: To find the Eye of Ra and block the spread of Pure Evil, Flynn enters the mysteries of the Bermuda Triangle and faces a sequence of trials designed to test who he really is.

s03e07.description: A magically amplified love potion turns abrasive Cindy Kroger into a mass obsession, and the Librarians must stop her plan to force the entire world into adoration.

s03e08.description: A series of spontaneous combustions leads the team to a wellness retreat run by vampires who have discovered a way to walk in daylight, with a dangerous price attached.

s03e09.description: The Monkey King's homeland of Shangri-La falls to a collector of magical artifacts, forcing the Librarians into a fight whose outcome threatens the balance sustaining the wider magical world.

s03e10.description: DOSA and Apep attack the Library from different directions at once, forcing Flynn, Baird, Stone, Cassandra, Ezekiel and Jenkins to reunite despite the conflicts that have fractured the team.
